questions.stem: If a context switch takes 5 microseconds on average, how many context switches can occur in one second? Provide your answer in switches per second.
questions.explanation: One second is 1,000,000 microseconds. If each context switch takes 5 microseconds, then the number of context switches per second is 1,000,000 / 5 = 200,000 switches per second.

questions.stem: A system performs 50,000 context switches in 0.25 seconds. What is the average time per context switch in microseconds?
questions.explanation: The total time for 50,000 context switches is 0.25 seconds, which is 250,000 microseconds. Therefore, the average time per context switch is 250,000 / 50,000 = 5 microseconds.
